data.title: Bar, Pub and Brewery Taproom
data.summary: A realistic pub bar, cellar and brewery taproom: counter run, dispense fonts and hand pulls, under-bar kit, back bar, seating, tanks, casks and glassware.
data.description: Bar-level inspection and a room layout in one coherent modern realistic family. The dispense system is the point of the pack: tap fonts are lathed columns carrying individually cast taps, each with a flanged shank, a swan body falling to a nozzle, a lever pivot boss and a turned handle over a slotted drip tray, and hand pulls are complete beer engines with a chrome C-clamp gripping the bar, a polished barrel, a swan-neck spout and a long curved lever ending in a ball grip. The counter is fielded pub joinery on a 1.2 m counter-run grid with a corner, a lift-flap end and a brass foot rail; the back bar tiles on its own 1.2 m grid through bottle steps, mirror, glazed fridge and shelf bays; casks sit in vee chocks on a stillage that tiles at 1.2 m. Under-bar equipment is chamfered stainless on adjustable bullet feet, seating carries crowned piped pads and welted buttoned back pads, and the brewery side is real vessel construction with dished heads, banded shells, oval manways, butterfly valves and splayed legs. Named pivoted nodes cover the counter lift flap and gate, the cellar cooler door, bottle and keg fridge doors, till drawers, lids, flaps and the dartboard cabinet doors, and each ships a rigid open and close clip on its own pivot: node transforms only, no skinning. All original CC0 geometry: every sign, pump clip, board, menu, label and picture face is blank, with no brands, brewery names or artwork. Excludes pool, billiards and bowling, casino gaming, stage and studio equipment and arcade cabinets, which belong to other packs.
